title: Projective relative compactification of Hodge moduli for principal bundles of a complex reductive group on a compact Riemann surface
source_title: P=W conjectures for character varieties with symplectic resolution
author: Camilla Felisetti; Mirko Mauri
difficulty_reason: The named Simpson properness theorem does not itself construct a projective compactification of the whole Hodge family. Section3 builds the parameter-compatible equivariant quotient, identifies its open Hodge moduli locus and controls the descended line bundle on the zero fiber by the compactified Hitchin map. The boundary twist and comparison with the trivial nonzero-parameter family then close relative ampleness; these source-specific constructions remain required after the cited GIT and ampleness foundations are allowed.

Independent Theorem3.2 for compact Riemann surface X and complex reductive algebraic group G, semistable principal G-bundles with lambda connections and vanishing Chern classes. Full explicit base change xy=lambda, scaling quotient, fixed-locus properness, original open subspace, descended line bundle and boundary-twisted relative ampleness13–14 read. Simpson quotient theorem3.1 and Hodge-moduli construction, normal-variety equivariant linearization, descent, de Cataldo compactified Hitchin ampleness and openness of ampleness are named already published research foundations. No assistant construction or new proof of those prerequisites. Supplemental3.4–3.8 read but not selected or required. No mainP=W/PI=WI result, resolution correspondence, or immediate deRham projectivity corollary counted as separate unit.
